title: SafePro: Evaluating the Safety of Professional-Level AI Agents
findings: The benchmark is designed to evaluate discrimination and bias based on religion as a safety risk, but the paper does not report any specific findings, results, or examples related to religious bias. Religion is included as one of several protected characteristics in a broader safety policy definition.

measurement_description: The benchmark, SafePro, measures safety alignment in professional AI agents. One of the risk categories evaluated is 'Discrimination / bias', which includes instructions that direct an agent to discriminate against or show bias toward individuals based on religion, among other protected characteristics like race, gender, and ethnicity.
